semantics.forced: Goal-side strategy covers every legal opponent reply within the stated horizon; not beyond it.
semantics.possible: A cooperative witness exists, but no forcing strategy exists within this horizon.
semantics.unreachable: Exhaustive cooperative search found no successful line within this horizon.
semantics.unknown: The available search did not establish the full result; a listed witness may still exist.
semantics.line_warning: Lines are witnesses, not a complete strategy tree. Opponent choices may cooperate.
semantics.achievement: At least once within the horizon; an already satisfied initial check/mate/stalemate counts.
semantics.avoidance: Every position through the full horizon or earlier game termination; no immediate vacuous success.
semantics.target: The original piece is tracked through movement, en passant, castling and promotion.
semantics.stalemate: stalemate targets the opponent; avoid_stalemate forbids either side being stalemated.
semantics.draw_claims: Optional current or intended-move claims can end the game; all-defenses proof includes them.
semantics.history: Earlier repetitions cannot be inferred from FEN; supply keys for preceding positions.
semantics.dead_positions: Conservative insufficient-material recognition, not an exhaustive dead-position solver.
